reason: The initial artifact scanner conservatively placed validation/test identifiers in a file named DESIGN_EXPOSED_IDS. Identifier-only overlap checking is required, but those identifiers are not development examples and no held-out text, labels, or outcomes were inspected. This amendment separates the active training exclusion registry from the locked held-out ID-only registry.

heldout_overlap_registry.forbidden_use: loading documents, questions, labels, evidence, answers, or metrics during development
